description: Na₄Ti₁₁O₂₄ is beta indium sulfide-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eleven TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-69°. There is one shorter (2.17 Å) and three longer (2.19 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eleven TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-71°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.17 Å. There are six inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.05 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.20 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.01 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.11 Å. In the fifth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.03 Å. In the sixth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.18 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra and edges with two ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form ONaTi₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two ONaTi₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramid, and edges with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaTi₃ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form ONaTi₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two ONaTi₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramid, and edges with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form ONaTi₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two ONaTi₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramid, and edges with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONaTi₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaTi₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramid, and edges with three ONaTi₃ tetrahedra.
